title: Kusanagi Nene — Because I'm Not Enough〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis

rows.Line: Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ms. Kazamatsuri's such a strict teacher...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I also can't believe I get to learn from her directly.)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I apologize for making you practice in a park like this, but we don't really have time to find a suitable rehearsal studio.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...!
If anything, thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Our primary goal will be to figure out what your habits are, Nene, and make it so your singing doesn't “stick out”.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Let's begin by hashing out what you need to fix and get the easy ones out of the way first.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: After all, it may be necessary since they could somehow be tied to these habits of yours.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes, good response!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
So, let's get started.
First, sing as the Cowardly Canary for me and give it everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
H-How did I do?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Like I said when we were at the cafe, you're very good. I actually really like the way you sing, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: It's the honest truth, but try to listen to what I am about to say with that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: First, you try to cover up the fact that you're running out of breath with a vibrato at the end.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You need to sing with the same volume all the way through.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you!
Would you mind if I took some notes?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Of course. And while we're on the subject of breathing...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Okay, that should just about cover it.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: As I suspected, there are some things we need to take care of before we can start working on your habits. We'll discuss that a little later.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: So, about fixing your habits...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Before we do, I'd like to hear how you arrived at your current portrayal of the Cowardly Canary. What made you think she sings this way?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? But... If I don't move away from that, I'll end up ruining our show...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That only has to do with your habits. It has nothing to do with how you choose to play the Cowardly Canary, no?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: And I have to believe that you arrived at this portrayal of her after giving it an enormous amount of thought.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I'd rather not see all your hard work go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Having to hear that I have a long list of problems to deal with wasn't easy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But if I can work on them with Ms. Kazamatsuri, I might just...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm not giving up...
I have to stick through this until the end...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll look over the notes I took today, review what we covered and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe. Before I do...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Hiii, Neneee!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<How's singing practice going?!
I hope you're not feeling too lonely.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Oh, I forgot. Robo-Nene's at home with you, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Emu, wait!
You're getting off track!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Ahem...
Today, Nene, we've put this video together in the hopes that it'll give you some encouragement!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<We hope you get to watch this.
Now, it's showtime!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm not alone...
I have friends who believe in me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe...
No matter how many times I watch this, it still feels so dumb.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I should tell them how Ms. Kazamatsuri agreed to teach me...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
<You can do it, Nene!>
<You can do it, Neneee!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys...
I promise to do my best and see this through.
